comparison.objective: Roll puff pastry into an even 3 mm sheet of sufficient length without sealing its ends.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually keep a spacer-ring rolling pin level through repeated rolling passes.
comparison.success_condition: Sheet reaches at least 20 cm with at least 90% near 3 mm, no rolled-over ends, and pin released level.
comparison.reason: Deformable-sheet rolling and thickness control do not test impact fracture, recessed insert alignment, or fragment recovery.
